requirement: Every semantically relevant item crossing an input/output interface, independent of modality or payload kind, is durably represented in a repository-bound work unit. At suitable granularity and only when epistemically and publication-wise connectable, a derived claim is machine-checked and advanced to a Zenodo publication candidate and, when protocol-standardization relevance exists, to an IETF Internet-Draft candidate. The repository-side path is automated and fail-closed.

scope.semantic_relevance_rule: Persist every interface event needed to reconstruct the work, provenance, decision, claim, or external effect. Transport-noise bytes MAY be normalized only under an explicitly versioned normalization rule while retaining a digest of the observed payload where technically available.
scope.raw_sensitive_payload_rule: Do not publish raw private, secret, credential, personal, copyrighted, or otherwise restricted payload merely to satisfy persistence. Persist a content-addressed/redacted evidence envelope when full bytes cannot lawfully or safely be stored.

machine_proof_rule.formalizable: Machine proof means proof/checking inside the declared formal system against exact source/toolchain bindings.
machine_proof_rule.non_formalizable: Do not fabricate a theorem. Persist evidence, epistemic classification, verification method and unresolved remainder instead.
machine_proof_rule.empirical_boundary: Formal derivability does not imply physical correspondence or empirical confirmation.

publication_rule.zenodo_candidate: Eligible only after repository persistence, exact artifact binding, rights/license checks, claim granularity selection and required proof/evidence receipts.
publication_rule.ietf_candidate: Eligible only when the result has protocol, interoperability, architecture, operational or standards-track/research-group relevance suitable for IETF-style publication.
publication_rule.external_effect: Candidate generation is automatable; production Zenodo/IETF mutation remains a separately authorized and verified external effect unless a narrower standing authorization explicitly permits it.

automation_acceptance_criteria.repository_capture: A conforming client emits a work-unit envelope for every semantically relevant I/O event.
automation_acceptance_criteria.repository_gate: CI validates every newly persisted work unit and rejects malformed or proof-inflating records.
automation_acceptance_criteria.claim_router: Eligible claims are deterministically routed to proof/evidence and publication-candidate stages.
automation_acceptance_criteria.effect_boundary: No production external mutation occurs without applicable authorization and post-effect receipt.
automation_acceptance_criteria.idempotency: Identical normalized events produce stable content fingerprints and MUST NOT create semantic-noise loops.
automation_acceptance_criteria.reconstruction: A later conforming client can reconstruct the work/decision/proof/publication state from repository evidence without relying on chat memory.
